# Awtarchy v3.7.0 Quickshell

Awtarchy v3.7.0 expands the native Quickshell lockscreen into a full visual customization system with secure desktop-to-lockscreen transitions, direct-manipulation editing, custom elements, background composition, local information, and a responsive audio visualizer. It also makes `Super+P` open immediately and defers secure capture until the user actually chooses Lock, while fixing a fresh-install version-state permissions failure.

## Install and update

Fresh installation: [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/dillacorn/awtarchy/blob/main/INSTALL.md)

Existing Awtarchy installations and stable updates: [UPDATING.md](https://github.com/dillacorn/awtarchy/blob/main/UPDATING.md)

Quick update:

```bash
awtarchy update
```

## Lockscreen editor and customization

- Adds a visual lockscreen editor with direct drag/resize manipulation, numeric precision controls, arrow-key nudging, snapping/guides, undo/redo, multi-selection, group editing, presets, and per-element reset/default controls.
- Adds editable custom images and text, repeated timezone clocks, weather/local information, custom lockscreen wallpaper state, and broader scale/rotation/opacity controls while keeping the password element required.
- Custom images support selection, deletion, rotation, scaling, opacity, reset behavior, entry effects, and persisted placement with secure/editor presentation parity where required.
- Background controls are editor-owned and include wallpaper fit/focal placement, brightness, blur, opacity/transparency, and solid-color backgrounds.

## Secure transitions and background composition

- Locks now use per-output frozen pre-lock desktop captures as secure presentation backing after `WlSessionLock` takes ownership; the live unlocked compositor is never exposed through lockscreen transparency.
- Fade, Pixel / Resolution Collapse, Edges, and Wipe transition from the captured desktop into the real lockscreen scene before normal element entrance motion begins.
- Background transparency and blur compose against the frozen desktop backing, including non-wallpaper backgrounds; invalid or missing capture data fails closed to an opaque secure result.
- Editor transition replay and frozen-desktop preview use isolated preview capture state rather than secure lock capture storage.

## Interactive presentation and visualizer

- Restores responsive AWTARCHY wordmark hover deformation with bounded click-explosion physics, spring return, repeated impulse handling, and idle-safe solver behavior.
- Adds a standalone CAVA/PipeWire visualizer with straight, arc, and circle modes plus sensitivity, performance, width, bend, positioning, persistence, and reset controls.
- Visualizer and presentation effects remain separate from authentication ownership and safely tolerate missing or malformed audio data.

## Power Menu and lock responsiveness

- `Super+P` now opens the Power Menu immediately without taking a screenshot just for opening the menu.
- Rapid `Super+P -> L` input remains compositor-owned before Quickshell maps, while fresh secure capture is deferred until Lock is actually selected.
- On `L`, the Power Menu hard-hides without its normal exit animation, waits for its backing windows to unmap, allows a short compositor-settle interval, then starts the fresh secure capture and lock transition.
- Timeout/duplicate-action paths no longer remap the Power Menu during a committed lock handoff, preventing the observed menu flash during the transition.
- Non-lock Power Menu actions avoid unnecessary lockscreen capture.

## Fresh-install reliability

- Fixes a root-run fresh-install failure where version metadata staging could be unreadable by the target user and abort with `Permission denied`.
- Version-state staging is now created and handled as the target user while preserving the normal command/config version metadata.

- All 14 merged-main push workflows triggered for the exact release target completed successfully, including the full `Validate Awtarchy` updater/integration suite and the focused Quickshell lockscreen validations.
- PR #181's final accepted feature candidate completed all 28 returned PR-triggered workflows successfully after repeated Hyprland/Quickshell runtime passes.
- The final merged `Super+P -> L` hard-hide/capture sequencing was runtime-tested by the maintainer on `main` and confirmed working before this release.
- The fresh-install permissions fix was developed with a reproduced failing regression followed by a green full integration run.
